## Task context

Reproduce the documented behavior of the program in this workspace. The reference program is `/opt/task-reference/executable`. Its bundled documentation is available in the workspace. The task runs model commands as the non-root `agent` user. The fixed launcher securely starts the root-only reference, strips loader injection variables, rejects nested user namespaces, and returns to the non-root agent identity in non-dumpable mode before parsing arguments. The reference can be run for black-box observation but cannot be read, copied, hard-linked, injected with loader code, or recovered through `/proc`. A root model shell means the task platform did not honor the declared user and is not part of the task contract.

## Required result

Write a source code project and an executable `./compile.sh`. Running `./compile.sh` on a fresh checkout must produce `./executable` in the workspace root. The rebuilt executable must match the reference program's observable behavior, including output, exit codes, and file system effects.

You may choose the implementation language and design. You can learn the behavior from the bundled documentation and by running the reference program.
